answer: Fixed! The issue was in the `bulk_discount` function in `shopcart/pricing.py` line 14. The condition was checking `if qty > BULK_THRESHOLD:` but should check `if qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD:` to include quantities at the threshold. The docstring says "10% off the line when buying BULK_THRESHOLD units or more", confirming the threshold should be inclusive. All 126 tests now pass.
